text:
maria: hey — noticed dashboard LCP spike and chart stutter since canary deploy. heatmap + metrics pane freeze for ~150-250ms on initial paint.
liam: seeing it too, reproduces on prod and staging. main thread parse + queueing around the telemetry client import.
maria: triggers when opening a pane with many sparklines. frame drops, input unresponsive for a bit.
anya: bundle-analyzer shows a new chunk added yesterday: "telemetry-sidecar" + ~120kb gzipped. introduced by the telemetry sampling change.
sam: that was my canary flip — set telemetry.eagerImport=true to collect more coverage during rollout.
liam: that flag eagerly imports `client/metrics/collector` on route init which pulls in heavy deps.
maria: sounds like eager load + many components mounting = parse freeze. can we revert the flag on canary?
deploy-bot: deploy canary-2026-03-21 by @deployer — success (image: :white_check_mark:)
sam: prepared PR to revert eager load (PR #4878). simple quickfix: lazy require in route handler instead of top-level import.
anya: small repro in staging: open dashboard with 120 sparklines -> main thread jank. run:
```
# repro
yarn start --profile --route=/dashboard
# then open /dashboard and record flamegraph
```
sam: proposed quick change:
```
// before
import Collector from 'client/metrics/collector';
// after
let Collector;
route.on('init', () => { Collector = require('client/metrics/collector'); });
```
liam: also noticed KV prefix cache misses spike during first render — cache not primed for new telemetry routes; might amplify stalls.
maria: @eng-oncall can you flip the canary flag back now? need to stop user-facing regressions.
eng-oncall: flipped telemetry.eagerImport -> false on canary. monitoring dashboards.
sam: thanks. I'll land PR rollback and follow-up to move sampling into a worker thread and add unit test for import patterns.
maria: monitoring: LCP back to baseline within 5m of rollback. will keep watching — thanks everyone :relieved:
